scope.source_data: Original nationwide CSVs re-read independently; no primary parser/model imports
scope.primary_reference: Every primary stratum/candidate, every joint-tail case, magnitudes, local peers and exclusive coverage
scope.ratios: Fraction-based exact ties, medians and practical-effect thresholds
scope.simulations: All 19999 draws regenerated for each of the 15 independent seeded streams; every cached count audited
scope.p_values: Exceedance counts, plus-one raw p-values, linear quantiles, 15-member Holm family and decisions
scope.sensitivities: Alternative descriptive scenarios are not independently recomputed here
scope.interpretation: Conditional independence benchmark is not a null of natural elections; consistency does not authenticate the sources
